patternEn: Let's play it by ear [and see how the day goes].
usageNote: play it by ear = 不提前计划、随机应变。比 decide later 更地道，适合朋友和同事之间。

examples.en: We don't have a fixed plan — let's play it by ear and see how the day goes.
examples.zh: 我们没定死计划，看当天情况吧。

examples.en: I'm not sure how long the meeting will run, so let's play it by ear on dinner.
examples.zh: 不确定会议要多久，晚饭看情况吧。

substitutions.en: and see how the day goes
and figure it out when we get there

patternEn: We cut it close [on the flight].
usageNote: cut it close = 时间卡得很紧、差点错过。用于赶飞机、交稿、赶末班车都自然。

examples.en: We cut it close on the flight — boarding had already started.
examples.zh: 我们差点没赶上飞机，登机都开始了。

examples.en: We cut it close with the deadline, but we made it.
examples.zh: 截止日期卡得很紧，不过赶上了。

patternEn: Off the top of my head, [I'd say around fifty].
usageNote: 表示没细查、随口估计，先降低对方预期；开会临时被问数字时很救命。

examples.en: Off the top of my head, I'd say around fifty people showed up.
examples.zh: 凭印象，大概来了五十人。

examples.en: Off the top of my head, the project took about three months.
examples.zh: 粗略估计，项目做了三个月。

patternEn: That's a bit of a stretch [to call it a success].
usageNote: 委婉质疑对方的说法夸张或站不住脚；比 That's wrong 柔和，但态度明确。

examples.en: That's a bit of a stretch to call it a success.
examples.zh: 说它成功有点牵强。

examples.en: Saying we're ready is a bit of a stretch.
examples.zh: 说我们准备好了有点勉强。

patternEn: At the end of the day, [it's your call].
usageNote: 总结时把话题拉回本质；比 in the end 更口语，也常用来把决定权交出去。

examples.en: At the end of the day, it's your call.
examples.zh: 说到底，决定权在你。

examples.en: At the end of the day, the customer decides.
examples.zh: 说到底，客户说了算。

substitutions.en: we have to look at the data

patternEn: Take [his estimate] with a grain of salt.
usageNote: 提醒别人信息未必可靠，别全信；grain of salt 是固定搭配，不要说 a grain of sugar。

examples.en: Take his estimate with a grain of salt — he tends to exaggerate.
examples.zh: 他的估计别全信，他容易夸大。

examples.en: Take the reviews with a grain of salt; most of them are fake.
examples.zh: 那些评论别全信，很多是假的。

patternEn: Let's take this offline [and come back with a proposal].
usageNote: 会议里把跑题或敏感话题挪出公开讨论，非常高频；不打断会议节奏。

examples.en: Let's take this offline and come back with a proposal.
examples.zh: 这个我们私下聊，回头拿个方案。

examples.en: Can we take this offline? It's a bit detailed for now.
examples.zh: 这个私下说行吗？现在讲太细了。

substitutions.en: and come back with a proposal
and pick it up after the call
and get a smaller group together

patternEn: I'll loop [you] in on the details.
usageNote: loop someone in = 把某人拉进沟通/同步信息；比 tell you later 更职场。

examples.en: I'll loop you in on the details after the call.
examples.zh: 会后我把细节同步给你。

examples.en: Let me loop in the design team before we decide.
examples.zh: 决定前我把设计团队拉进来。

usageNote: park = 暂时搁置。会议里比 Let's stop talking about it 礼貌，也不显得否定对方。

examples.en: Can we park that for now and come back to it?
examples.zh: 这个先放一放，回头再说？

examples.en: Let's park the budget discussion until Monday.
examples.zh: 预算讨论先搁到周一。

patternEn: I wanted to give you a heads-up about [the delay].
usageNote: heads-up = 提前告知，避免对方被突发消息砸到；比 I want to tell you 更专业。

examples.en: I wanted to give you a heads-up about the delay.
examples.zh: 先跟你说一声，项目要延期。

examples.en: Just a heads-up — the client moved the meeting.
examples.zh: 提前说一声，客户改了会议时间。
